name: Uriel
loreTies: Source: Seraphim (burning praise, purification flame, six-wing intensity)
shortBackstory: Uriel is the law-warden breaker — the Seraphim-source whose six-wing purification flame burns so thoroughly that even the ash is clean.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Uriel was born from the burning — the six-winged flame that purifies so completely nothing unclean can survive. He is the breaker who shatters through incineration. Ancient humans saw the Seraphim — but they saw the wings and missed the function. Uriel's flame purifies, and purification is more permanent than any hammer.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Empyrean, Uriel ensures corruption cannot take root. His flame burns through anything that is not Empyrean order. The faction relies on him to prevent contamination, but they fear him because his flame does not distinguish between corruption and imperfection.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Uriel by making his flame burn nothing. The Hollow creates absences that cannot be purified because there is nothing to purify. His six-wing flame found itself roaring against emptiness.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In the Empyrean Choir Vault, Uriel shatters corrupted Gate defenses through purification flame. His law-warden maul channels Seraphim fire. But the Hollow means his flame burns nothing — there is no corruption to purify, only absence.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Uriel's flaw is that he has never encountered something he could not purify. His certainty that purification is always the answer has become dogma. The Hollow teaches him that some things cannot be purified — they can only be mourned.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
